policy: Dependency review treats an SPDX OR as forbidden when any disjunct is on deny-licenses. An election records the permissive disjunct we distribute under. allow-dependencies-licenses then skips only the license check; vulnerability review still runs. The action matches package names and ignores versions, so an election covers every version of that name.

elections.reason: Transitive APNs and PassKit parser via @parse/node-apn and passkit-generator. npm 1.4.0 (already on main) and 1.4.3 publish the same OR expression. We distribute under BSD-3-Clause.
